pose: A side-flattened (deep) tail that is very stiff at the base.
visual_hook: The 'Tall Tail'. The spines on top and bottom make the tail look like a tall, flat paddle or an oar.
material: Matte, ochre-toned bone. Criss-crossed with bony tendons.
inset_view: Top-right corner: Cross-section showing the tall, blade-like shape of the vertebrae.
